items.title: Scientists are about to test Einstein’s gravity with exotic matter
items.summary: Scientists have found a new way to create a controlled beam of muonium, an exotic atom containing a heavier cousin of the electron. items.title: Part-human part-mouse brain developed in science breakthrough
items.summary: Researchers at Stanford University genetically altered mice to be able to receive and function with human brain cells.

items.title: Scientists restore a brain protein and reverse signs of aging in mice
items.summary: Scientists found that declining levels of the brain protein Menin may help drive aging, with lower levels in mice linked to inflammation, cognitive decline, weaker bones, and thinner skin. items.summary: Scientists discovered a population of cells that can start the process of programmed cell death, survive it, and then help rapidly rebuild damaged tissue.
